Writing each factor in terms of prime factorizations,
\[
\sqrt{75x}=\sqrt{3\cdot 5\cdot x}, \quad
\sqrt{2x}=\sqrt{2\cdot 2\cdot 2\cdot x}, \quad
\sqrt{14x}=\sqrt{2\cdot 7\cdot x}.
\]
Multiplying gives
\[
\sqrt{3\cdot5\cdot x \cdot 2\cdot2\cdot2\cdot x \cdot 2\cdot7\cdot x}
= \sqrt{3\cdot5\cdot2^4\cdot7\cdot x^2}
=\sqrt{(2^2\cdot x^2)(2^2\cdot3\cdot5\cdot7)}
= \boxed{4x\sqrt{105}}.
\]
